description: The Mud Mother Grove mud-hut INTERIOR, packaged as the linked inside for `mudmother:gv_meshes/argoniannest/mudhut01`. The mod ships `MudHut01IntNew` as that hut's matched interior — one round mud room authored to sit inside that one shell — so this kit packages the half that was already made to fit and adds only the dressing from the same folder. It is a single-room grammar: there are no wall bays and no corridor, and nothing here tiles. Everything already packaged in the exterior kit `settlement-mud-v1` (the hut shell, its thatch roof, the round floor plate, the woven table and chair, the outdoor braziers and fences) is deliberately not repeated; this kit holds the room and the props that only ever appear inside it. Built 2026-09-07: the blueprints named `mudhut01intnew` as the interior of fourteen parcels while no kit packaged it.

snapLogic.room: `mudhut01intnew` is a whole room, not a tile. It is placed at the same origin and yaw as the `mudhut01` exterior it belongs to; its doorway is the one modelled into that shell, so the two share a single opening and there is no separate door leaf in this pool.
snapLogic.shelving: `bookshelf`, `shelfsingle`, `hangingshelf` and `cavegbalconyshelf01` mount on the room's curved wall — the first two stand on the floor against it, the last two hang, so their origin sits at the wall plane rather than the floor plane.
snapLogic.furniture: `chitinchair01` and `argonianpillow01` are the floor seating; `ovennew` is the indoor hearth and wants the room's centre, clear of the wall.
snapLogic.dressing: `potterycup`, `potteryplate01-03`, `shellhalf`, `clam01`, `argonianbone01` and `drum01` are surface props for the shelves and the floor; `candle01`, `argonianlanterns01`, `argonianlanterns04` and `argonianbonechime02` are the light and the hanging dressing; `banner01` and `wallhanging01-03` are wall cloths and hang at the wall plane like the shelves.
snapLogic.unitScale: Bethesda units; 0.0142240 m/unit. Measured extents per piece in tooling/asset-pipeline/output/kits/mudmother-hut-int.kit.json.

light.evidence: Skyrim.esm: DefaultCandleLight01NS is the nearest LIGH ref (< 200 units, same cell) to 5 of 13 candle01 refs (next: SLightStreetStreet01 3; none 5); offset is the median of those 5 in the piece's frame, glTF Y-up metres, horizontal agreement 0.48 (below 0.6 the side is scatter and zeroed) (pipeline/mine_kit_lights.py).

Copied from settlement-mud-v1's argonianlanterns04 row (the same mod piece; the mod places its 3 refs with no LIGH within 200 units, so it takes argonianlanterns03's mined record SLightStreetStreet01 with the light at its own lantern body, 0.55 m below the pivot). Walk 6 look round 2: the hut interior's copy carried no light, so it never burned.
